# Sploot Vets

> > Sploot Veterinary Care provides emergency and primary care veterinary services across Denver, Chicago, and Colorado Springs with comprehensive pet health resources.

Sploot Vets operates multiple animal hospital locations offering services from routine wellness care to emergency treatment, surgical procedures, and compassionate end-of-life care. The site features extensive veterinary-approved educational content covering dog and cat health issues, preventive care, and safety guidance.

## Locations & Core Services

- [Veterinarian in Denver - Emergency Vet & Primary Care Animal Hospital | Sploot Vets](https://www.splootvets.com/locations/denver): Denver vet locations in Highlands, RiNo & Platt Park with emergency care
- [Compassionate Pet Euthanasia for Dogs & Cats](https://www.splootvets.com/our-services/compassionate-pet-euthanasia-for-dogs-cats): End-of-life care services for dogs & cats in Denver, Chicago & Colorado Springs
- [Spay/Neuter Guide](https://www.splootvets.com/our-services/veterinary-surgery/dog-spay): Dog spay/neuter surgery guide with pricing & Sploot Pack options

## Common Health Issues & Symptoms

- [Cat Losing Weight: 12+ Reasons Why [Old Age, Health Issues & More]](https://www.splootvets.com/post/cat-losing-weight-reasons-why-old-age-health-issues-more): Causes of cat weight loss including hyperthyroidism & diabetes mellitus
- [Why is My Cat Not Eating: 11 Causes & Treatment [Vet-Approved]](https://www.splootvets.com/post/why-my-cat-not-eating-causes-treatment-vet-approved): Cat appetite loss causes including stress, picky eating & health issues
- [10+ Common Allergies in Dogs & Treatment: Food, Pollen, & Beyond](https://www.splootvets.com/post/common-allergies-in-dogs-treatment): Dog allergy guide covering flea dermatitis, food & environmental allergies
- [Dog Scooting (Dragging) Butt on Floor: 7+ Reasons & Remedies](https://www.splootvets.com/post/dog-scooting-butt): Causes & treatments for dog scooting including anal glands & parasites
- [Dog Flu [Canine Influenza]: Symptoms, Vaccine, & Treatment](https://www.splootvets.com/post/dog-flu-canine-influenza-symptoms-vaccine-treatment): Canine influenza guide covering H3N2/H3N8 strains, symptoms & vaccine info
